- Update MyGo from 0.6.4 to 0.7.3 and golang.org/x/net to 0.62.0.
- Fix the desktop widget's rounded corners: its panel now blends smoothly with the wallpaper instead of showing a grey edge.
- Keep the widget on the desktop layer, above the wallpaper and below other apps. It stays visible with Show Desktop (Win+D), and dragging, resizing, and saved placement continue to work.

Download the Windows x64 or ARM64 ZIP, extract it, and run `Countdowner.exe`. Keep the `licenses/` directory. Portable and unsigned.
